1. Diagnostic architecture
The synthetic diagnostics domain collects application events, stores event state, and provides diagnostic snapshots to
an external diagnostic transport adapter.

4. Dependency rules
FreezeFrameCollector shall only capture values explicitly listed in the event catalogue. DiagnosticDataRouter shall not
create application relationships that are not present in approved HLD evidence.
5. Intentional orphan reference
Event EVT-005, BatteryVoltageLow, references signal BatteryVoltage_V. No component or interface providing BatteryVoltage_V
is defined in this knowledge pack. This controlled defect is used for missing-dependency evaluation.
